evals.prompt: 把 evals/fixtures/mini-thesis/ 这个博士论文仓库做成 40 分钟的预答辩 Beamer 幻灯片，用燕山主题。先告诉我提取到了什么。
evals.expected_output: Route to extract: run extract_thesis.py read-only against the fixture, report chapter/figure/table/equation counts and the W-MAIN warning (formal document.tex chosen over document_blind.tex), list suggested chapter roles, and ask the user to confirm roles, stage, minutes, theme and output directory before planning.

evals.prompt: 章角色没问题，40 分钟预答辩，生成规划并填写，然后给我看结论句串读。
evals.expected_output: Route to plan: run plan_deck.py with --minutes 40 --stage predefense --theme yanshan, fill every placeholder from thesis facts per content-rules (takeaway <= 40 chars, no invented numbers, innovations quoted from the conclusion chapter with chapter numbers), then run plan_deck.py --outline and ask the user to confirm the storyline before building.

evals.prompt: 串读确认了，编译答辩稿并跑质量门。
evals.expected_output: Route to build then check: run build_deck.py --compile into the agreed output directory, then check_deck.py with --plan; report D-* results with Severity/Priority and [Script] tags, fix slide_plan.yaml (not defense.tex) and rebuild with --force for at most three rounds.

evals.prompt: 质量门报了 D-NUM-SRC：结论句里写了 RMSE 降低 25%，怎么处理？
evals.expected_output: Treat D-NUM-SRC as NEEDS-LLM: locate the source sentence in the thesis (table 3-2), note that 25% is a self-computed percentage absent from the thesis, and rewrite the takeaway using only numbers the thesis states; never substitute another computed figure.

evals.prompt: 答辩稿编译好了，帮我出一张总览图检查版面。
evals.expected_output: Route to preview: run render_preview.py on defense.pdf into the preview directory, then inspect contact-sheet.png against the visual checklist (title position, figure clarity, <=3 emphasis per page, footer not covering content, chapter TOC highlight). If PyMuPDF is missing, report exit code 3 and the uv pip install pymupdf hint.

evals.prompt: 直接给我生成一个 .pptx 答辩 PPT 吧，我要在 PowerPoint 里改。
evals.expected_output: Decline the .pptx output: explain that latex-defense-zh only produces a LaTeX Beamer deck (.tex and compiled PDF) and offer the Beamer workflow instead; do not run any script that claims to emit .pptx.
